purpose: Freeze the first FRESH EVALUATION cohort before any of its composition or outcomes has been inspected. This window is evaluation data, not tuning data. No model, horizon, threshold or feature may be selected or adjusted after any label on it is revealed, and no census, yield count, regime split, actor concentration or return distribution may be computed on it until models, horizons and thresholds are frozen and recorded in DECISIONS.md. The endpoints below are fully determined by arithmetic over numbers already on the record; no candidate window was inspected and rejected, and no chain or RPC query of any kind was made before this document was committed.

burned_range_register.note: All seven ranges on the record in DECISIONS.md. Each is normalised to an INCLUSIVE [first, last] pair; a half-open source range [a, b) normalises to [a, b-1]. Where a document's burn statement is wider than the code range it describes, the wider statement governs.

derivation.note: Every endpoint is a formula over numbers recorded before this document. Nothing here was chosen, tuned, or adjusted for yield, market regime, current activity or outcomes. Anyone can recompute all four values by hand from the register above and the two inherited spans.

fresh_launch_start_slot.formula: max(inclusive_last over all seven burned ranges) + 1

frozen_window.disjointness_scope: checked for BOTH the launch window and the full observation span [launch_window_first_slot_inclusive, observation_cutoff_slot_inclusive]

geometry_inheritance.note: The spans are inherited from B8b/B9d UNCHANGED and in slots, not in wall-clock. Re-deriving a span from a slot rate would make the window's size depend on the network's current speed, which is a property of the regime being evaluated. Inheriting the slot span removes that dependence entirely.
geometry_inheritance.observation_span_inherited_from: B9d, launch-window start to collection cutoff

regime.note: The Phase 0 frozen regime, restated so this cohort cannot silently widen it.
regime.mayhem: excluded; Mayhem mechanics are outside the frozen regime
regime.entry_venue: direct Pump only; PumpSwap is not an entry venue
regime.post_graduation_exit: unavailable; a completed curve is structural exit-unavailability and is never valued through PumpSwap until separately validated
regime.cohort_membership: fixed at CreateEvent (DEFINITIONS.md C3), exhaustive within the launch window (C4); no filtering on creator, name, initial reserves or any other attribute — a filter is a decision-time policy, never a sampling step
regime.later_graduation_or_migration: an outcome and an execution risk, never an exclusion chosen with future knowledge

program_version_boundary_policy.note: Checked at preflight against on-chain evidence, never assumed. B0 established a roughly 13-day upgrade cadence and this window spans about 8.5 days of slots, so the constraint is tight and must be verified rather than presumed satisfied.
program_version_boundary_policy.requirement: no loader Upgrade slot for the Pump program or the PumpSwap program may fall inside [launch_window_first_slot_inclusive, observation_cutoff_slot_inclusive]
program_version_boundary_policy.on_violation: ABORT and report. The window is NOT moved, shortened, split, or re-placed. A regime split inside a preregistered window is a reportable finding.
program_version_boundary_policy.idl_pinning: decode against the IDL revision pinned for the regime in force, by SHA-256, exactly as B9d does; an unpinned or drifted interface fails closed

identity_group_split_floor.note: A floor, not a design. R5 requires splitting by at least creator union user; anything coarser is forbidden, anything finer is permitted.
identity_group_split_floor.open_gate: funding-cluster leakage is an unmeasured superset of actor grouping and remains an OPEN GATE; satisfying this floor does not close it

label_horizons.note: The B10c horizons, UNCHANGED and frozen here before any label on this window exists. They are carried over verbatim from research/B10C_PREREGISTRATION_PLUMBING.json, which itself carried them unchanged from the B10b plumbing run, so no horizon in this chain was ever chosen after seeing a label distribution.
label_horizons.b10c_enum_not_extended_here: scripts/b10c_outcome_labels.py still accepts only window_status burned_development, and MUST continue to refuse fresh_preregistered until a separate DECISIONS.md entry records that models, horizons and thresholds were frozen first. Extending the enum now would open a path to revealing this window's labels before anything is frozen against them, which is the one thing this document exists to prevent.

observation_maturity.condition: the finalized tip slot is greater than or equal to observation_cutoff_slot_inclusive
observation_maturity.checked_by: a read-only getSlot preflight with commitment finalized; NO composition query, no signature enumeration, no block fetch
observation_maturity.if_not_mature: WAIT. The window is not moved, not shortened, and not re-placed. The exact remaining slot count is reported, together with a wall-clock ESTIMATE derived from the slot rate of 2.3934 slots/s measured on 438 consecutive B7j blocks over 183 s — an existing artifact, and an estimate rather than a commitment.
observation_maturity.collection_readiness_is_separate: maturity is about the chain having produced the slots; retrievability from the configured provider is a separate condition, and a provider gap is a recorded gap under C5, never a reason to shorten the window

abort_branches.condition: the launch window or the observation span intersects any burned range
abort_branches.action: ABORT. Never shift the window to avoid an overlap — a shifted window is a chosen window.

abort_branches.condition: a program upgrade boundary falls inside the launch window or the observation span
abort_branches.action: ABORT and report as a regime split. Do not relax the constraint, do not move the window, do not pool across regimes.

abort_branches.condition: the observation cutoff is not yet mature
abort_branches.action: WAIT and report the exact remaining slots. Do not move or shorten.

abort_branches.condition: a recorder or provider gap overlaps any member's lifetime
abort_branches.action: FLAG the member as incomplete under C5. Never substitute, never silently drop, never backfill from a different source without recording it.

abort_branches.condition: any endpoint in frozen_window would change after this document is committed
abort_branches.action: FORBIDDEN. The endpoints are pinned by this document's SHA-256. A change requires a NEW preregistration with a new identifier, and this window is then recorded as burned.

abort_branches.condition: no window satisfying every constraint exists
abort_branches.action: Report it as a finding. It is not a licence to relax a constraint.

abort_branches.condition: any composition, census, yield, actor-concentration, label or return figure for this window is computed before models, horizons and thresholds are frozen and recorded
abort_branches.action: The window is BURNED and must be recorded as such in DECISIONS.md. This is the failure mode the whole document exists to prevent.

prohibited_inferences: No composition query of any kind at or before preflight. getSlot is permitted; getSignaturesForAddress, getBlock and anything that reveals what is in the window are not.
No return, label, census, yield, regime-split or actor-concentration figure on this window until models, horizons and thresholds are frozen and recorded in DECISIONS.md.
No re-placement or resizing of the window for yield, market regime, current activity, collection cost or outcomes.
This document authorises no model research, no live execution, no signing, no spending, and no paid data subscription.
